title: WIZ CLOUD – VULNERABILITIES BY TIME & ENVIRONMENT
description: Open AWS vulnerability findings, Critical through Low. Trends use actual collection snapshots, not detection-date estimates. Current breakdown and list are not restricted by the time picker. Types come from Wiz artifactType.group, not asset type: container findings may contain OS packages or application libraries. Historical snapshots without type metadata remain Unknown; selecting a specific type excludes that older unclassified history. Existing category totals and historical counts are preserved.

list.name: environment
list.label: Environment
list.query: SELECT subscription_name FROM wiz_active_issues WHERE source = 'vulnerabilityFindings' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' UNION SELECT subscription_name FROM wiz_snapshots WHERE metric_type = 'VULNERABILITY' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' ORDER BY 1

list.name: vuln_type
list.label: Vulnerability Type
list.query: SELECT COALESCE(v.vuln_type, 'Unknown') FROM wiz_vulnerabilities v JOIN wiz_active_issues a ON a.id = v.finding_id WHERE a.cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND a.subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) UNION SELECT COALESCE(vuln_type, 'Unknown') FROM wiz_snapshots WHERE metric_type = 'VULNERABILITY' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Vulnerabilities Over Time by Environment
panels.description: Open AWS findings (Critical, High, Medium and Low) at each successful collection. No synthetic history. Historical types are Unknown until typed snapshots begin.

targets.rawSql: SELECT recorded_at AS "time", subscription_name AS metric, SUM(issue_count)::double precision AS value FROM wiz_snapshots WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at) AND metric_type = 'VULNERABILITY' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(vuln_type, 'Unknown') IN (${vuln_type:sqlstring}) GROUP BY recorded_at, subscription_name ORDER BY recorded_at, subscription_name;

panels.title: Vulnerabilities Over Time by Severity
panels.description: Open AWS findings at collection time. Critical, High and Medium only; Low is intentionally omitted from this chart.

targets.rawSql: SELECT recorded_at AS "time", severity AS metric, SUM(issue_count)::double precision AS value FROM wiz_snapshots WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at) AND metric_type = 'VULNERABILITY' AND cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND severity IN ('CRITICAL', 'HIGH', 'MEDIUM') AND subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(vuln_type, 'Unknown') IN (${vuln_type:sqlstring}) GROUP BY recorded_at, severity ORDER BY recorded_at, severity;

panels.title: Vulnerabilities by Type
panels.description: Current open AWS findings by Wiz artifact group, filtered by environment and type. Counts findings, not unique CVEs or assets. Independent of time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(v.vuln_type, 'Unknown') AS "Vulnerability Type", COUNT(*) AS "Findings" FROM wiz_vulnerabilities v JOIN wiz_active_issues a ON a.id = v.finding_id WHERE a.is_active AND a.status = 'OPEN' AND a.cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND a.severity IN ('CRITICAL', 'HIGH', 'MEDIUM', 'LOW') AND a.subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(v.vuln_type, 'Unknown') IN (${vuln_type:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY "Findings" DESC, 1;

panels.title: Vulnerabilities List
panels.description: Latest 1,000 currently open AWS findings, newest detections first. Other panels count all matching findings. The time picker controls trends only.

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.created_at AS "Detection Date", a.subscription_name AS "Environment", COALESCE(v.vuln_type, 'Unknown') AS "Vulnerability Type", a.severity AS "Severity", COALESCE(v.cve_id, v.vulnerability_id, a.rule_name) AS "CVE / Title", a.resource_name AS "Affected Resource" FROM wiz_vulnerabilities v JOIN wiz_active_issues a ON a.id = v.finding_id WHERE a.is_active AND a.status = 'OPEN' AND a.cloud_platform = 'AWS' AND a.severity IN ('CRITICAL', 'HIGH', 'MEDIUM', 'LOW') AND a.subscription_name IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(v.vuln_type, 'Unknown') IN (${vuln_type:sqlstring}) ORDER BY a.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, a.id LIMIT 1000;
